eval_cases.description: UC 1.1: POS Hardware Diagnostics - Certified troubleshooting protocol for ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze with double-charging precaution and clickable PDF documentation link.

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze on a Toshiba TCx 810 terminal, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

When encountering ERR-PAY-4001 (EMV PIN Pad Tokenization Timeout) on the Toshiba TCx 810, follow these certified recovery steps:
1. Prevent Double-Charging: Do NOT re-swipe, tap, or charge the customer card again immediately.
2. Reboot Payment Module: Hold Yellow + # on the payment PIN pad for 3 seconds.
3. Inspect Connection: Verify 12V PoweredUSB cable in rear I/O channel.
4. Audit Transaction Status: Navigate to Manager Menu -> Journal Audit Slip.
5. Resolution: If AUTHORIZED_UNSETTLED, print receipt slip; if VOIDED_ERROR, re-scan items and request card presentation.
Certified Documentation: https://storage.cloud.google.com/daelvate-module1-bucket/store_pos_manual_generic/Toshiba_TCx_810_Guide.pdf

eval_cases.description: UC 1.2: Enterprise Relational Analytics - Query store inventory reconciliation ledger for items with estimated cover hours under 20.0 to identify immediate stockout risks.

parts.text: Check the gold_inventory_reconciliation_ledger in BigQuery and report all store inventory positions where Estimated Cover Hours are less than 20.0, including product names and on-hand quantities.

eval_cases.description: Multi-Turn 1: Context Retention and Intent Switching - User transitions from store inventory queries to an urgent POS receipt printer cutter lock error (ERR-DN-PRNT-24V), verifying seamless domain switching.

parts.text: We just had a receipt printer cutter lock error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V on Lane 3. How do we clear the mechanical knife jam and resume printing receipts?

For error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V (24V Thermal Receipt Printer Cutter Lock / Knife Jam), follow the certified recovery runbook:
1. Power down the printer switch.
2. Open the cutter cover and rotate the manual feed thumb-wheel counter-clockwise until the guillotine knife fully retracts.
3. Clear jammed paper fragments from the transport path.
4. Close cover, re-engage latch, and power on to execute self-test print.
